question_text: Describe two devices needed to connect Wi-Fi laptops to an existing wired museum LAN.
adaptation_rationale: Network device functions and WAP/NIC explicit. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Wireless access point bridges wireless clients to wired LAN; wireless NIC in each laptop sends/receives wireless frames.

marking_points.criterion: Explains connection of wireless clients to wired LAN.
